problem_text: If R is a regular local ring with maximal ideal m and P ∈ Spec(R[x]) is a prime ideal with m = P ∩ R, then R[x]_P is regular.
solution_text: Proof: Since R is a regular local ring, R is a regular ring (regular local rings are regular). By the standard theorem that polynomial extensions of regular rings are regular, R[x] is a regular ring. Since P is a prime ideal of R[x], the localization R[x]_P is a regular local ring (localization of a regular ring at a prime yields a regular local ring). The condition m = P ∩ R ensures P lies over the maximal ideal of R, consistent with the local ring structure of R[x]_P.
